section.title: Purpose
section.p: Modern calendar systems provides to do lists, events, meetings as iCal files. Interfaces are provided to exchange data with other users or a central server. Often these systems have limited reporting and consolidation functions. The system we plan is an integration platform of calendar data and contacts management. The goal is to define a framework for reporting, consolidation and transformation functions. The system will never replace desktop personal information managers.

The requirements will support the iCal family of standards for time events and the vCard family of standards for all contacts. This approach guarantees compatibility with all major PIM systems and minimizes the cost for the interfaces. The major functions are.

ul.li: Multiple calendars are supported. A person can define multiple calendars such as work and private ones. The person can also subscribe to department, company and customer calendars.
A user can access public calendars of over persons to schedule meetings.
A person can define multiple contact lists such as work and private ones.
A user can subscribe to public contact lists of a department or a company.

section.title: Requirements
section.p: The test application to validate the pmmda application is a to do list manager. The complete application is generated from an UML model.
A todo item has the following information

dl.dd: string(255) defines the title of the todo item.
string(65536) is the description of the todo item.
reference code (low normal high) defines the priority of the todo item.
when the todo item should be started.
when the todo item should be completed.
percentage value indicating the progress of the todo item.
dynamic reference code identifying the owner of the item.
dynamic reference code of the project involved in the item.

section.p: A todo item can have dependencies to a set of todo items. The dependency means that the dependant todo must be completed before completing the owning item.
Obsolete owners or projects are displayed in grey. They cannot be selected for new todo items but are displayed for existing ones.
The list of todo item can be sorted through all the properties part of it. Completed todo items can be filtered out.

section.title: Planning
section.p: The first prototype is a proof of concept for the calendar functions. The client applications are Thunderbird, Firefox and Sunbird. The server functions will be provided through a WebDAV server. The events are stored using the iCal standards. The prototype provides reporting functions for events, meetings and to do items. The prototype will be started 1 March 2005 and be completed 31 March 2005.

The second prototype is a proof of concept for the address functions. The client applications are Thunderbird. The server functions will be provided trhough a WebDAV server. The contacts are stored using the vCard standards.
